{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Revenant''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that was active during the last days of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. After Thrawn's death at the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]], [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial intelligence]] sources reported that the ''Revenant'' was on a course that would lead to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref>
